facts.fact: Algeria's communications ministry said on 7 July 2024 that works on its territory for the Trans-Saharan fibre backbone are complete, 2,600 km of fibre from Algiers to In Guezzam plus a line extended to Tindouf.

MLI.note: Named only as one of six countries in the initiative; no agreement, works or service in Mali stated.
